description: This Java source file defines the class 'HeavensFamilyLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor', which extends the 'AbstractLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor'. It contains logic for processing loan repayment transactions, including handling on-time, late, advance, and refund transactions, specifically implementing a strategy tailored for 'HeavensFamily'. It manages how different components like interest, principal, fees, and penalties are paid or waived during different transaction scenarios.

classes.name: HeavensFamilyLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A specialized processor for handling loan repayment transactions following the 'HeavensFamily' strategy, controlling how payments are applied to different components of the loan during various repayment scenarios.

methods.name: HeavensFamilyLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the processor with dependencies.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the strategy.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late repayment transactions by paying interest first, then principal, similar to on-time payments.

methods.name: isTransactionInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Determines if a transaction date indicates an advance payment relative to due date.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles advance payments by paying only the principal component and waiving interest if entire principal is paid early.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes on-time installment payments, paying interest first then principal, with the possibility of waivers.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles refund transactions, unpaying components in reverse order: penalties, fees, interest, then principal.
